name: airdna (API Evangelist profile)
what_it_holds: Not a data repo — a third-party documentation/OpenAPI profile of the commercial AirDNA Enterprise API (market metrics, STR listing data, comparable-property sets, Rentalizer revenue estimates, occupancy/ADR/RevPAR/booking-lead-time/length-of-stay time series across 10M+ listings, 120k+ markets). Contains an OpenAPI spec, APIs.yml, Postman/Open API collections, and pricing/rate-limit metadata; explicitly 'no software, no data' — a map of what AirDNA's paid API exposes, not the data itself. Points to https://www.airdna.co (paid).
why_useful: Confirms exactly which realised-occupancy/ADR/booking-lead-time fields AirDNA sells (gap #2 and #3 candidate vendor), which is useful for scoping a potential paid-data ask, but yields nothing free or committed; low direct research value on its own.

name: Guess_the_Address
what_it_holds: Metis data-science capstone (7 stars, last active 2025). Uses 'AirDNA proprietary data' for Denver (avg. 833 properties within 500m circles around listings), VRBO/HomeAway data scraped/provided by AirDNA, and Denver Tax Assessor records, fuzzy-matched to ~429 linked records; goal is predicting a listing's true street address from AirDNA-anonymized data. Repo root has README, model/, munge/, scrape/, visualize/ folders but NO data/ directory and a .gitignore -- the underlying AirDNA/VRBO CSVs are not committed, confirmed via `gh api contents/`. Entire-home Denver listings only.
why_useful: Documents concretely what an AirDNA Denver export contains (fields, granularity, ~833-listing single-market size) and a working method (fuzzy match to tax-assessor records) for de-anonymizing/cross-referencing STR data, but ships no reusable data -- addresses gap #2 only as a description of the shape of AirDNA data, not as a source.
size_hint: no data files committed; code only
